claims.claim: Melissa Granum won the Delta mayoral race with 49 percent of the vote, 14,988 ballots, ahead of Dylan Kruger at 28 percent (8,567) and George Harvie at 23 percent (6,985) in results reported at 10 p.m.
claims.episode_span: Melissa Granum won the Delta mayoral race with 49 percent of the vote, 14,988 ballots
claims.source_title: B.C. Municipal Election Day Live: Latest news, results and reaction
claims.supporting_quote: Melissa Granum pulled off a landslide victory in Delta, with 49 per cent of the vote, 14,988 to Dylan Kruger’s 28 per cent (8,567), and George Harvie’s 23 per cent (6,985) at 10 p.m.

claims.claim: Doug McCallum unseated Brenda Locke with 31.9 percent to 23 percent, 42,741 votes to 30,886, with all 164 polls reporting.
claims.episode_span: taking 31.9 percent of the vote to Locke's 23 percent with all 164 polls reporting, 42,741 votes to 30,886
claims.source_title: Surrey Election Results: Brenda Locke unseated by former mayor Doug McCallum
claims.supporting_quote: With all 164 polls reporting, McCallum nabbed 31.9 per cent of the vote, followed by Locke with 23 per cent.

claims.claim: Pete Fry won Vancouver's municipal election Saturday, defeating incumbent Ken Sim and six other challengers.
claims.episode_span: Pete Fry won Saturday's municipal election, Business in Vancouver reported, defeating incumbent Ken Sim and six other challengers.
claims.source_title: Pete Fry becomes Vancouver's next mayor
claims.supporting_quote: Fry won the municipal election Saturday, defeating incumbent Ken Sim and six other challengers vying to lead British Columbia's largest city.

claims.episode_span: Voting places across Vancouver are closed, the City of Vancouver said
claims.source_title: All voting places now closed for Vancouver election
claims.supporting_quote: All voting places across Vancouver are now closed.

claims.claim: Voters in Kamloops elected two-term councillor Mike O'Reilly as mayor.
claims.episode_span: Voters in Kamloops elected two-term councillor Mike O'Reilly as mayor
claims.source_title: Kamloops voters choose former councillor Mike O’Reilly as mayor
claims.supporting_quote: Voters in Kamloops, B.C., have chosen a familiar face to lead council in the next four years, electing two-term councillor Mike O'Reilly.

claims.claim: A six-vehicle collision on Highway 99 Friday afternoon injured 13 people, and police are asking for dashcam footage.
claims.episode_span: a six-vehicle collision that injured 13 people on Highway 99 Friday afternoon
claims.source_title: Police asking for dashcam footage after 6-vehicle highway crash in Surrey
claims.supporting_quote: Police are asking anyone with dashcam footage of a multi-vehicle collision that injured 13 people on Highway 99 Friday afternoon to come forward.

claims.claim: Surrey police later said two people were seriously hurt and one was airlifted, after initially reporting no serious injuries.
claims.episode_span: two of the injured were seriously hurt and one was airlifted to hospital
claims.source_title: 2 seriously hurt, 11 others injured in B.C. crash that shut down Highway 99
claims.supporting_quote: Surrey police initially reported no serious injuries in the crash, but said late Friday night that two among the injured were seriously hurt and one was airlifted to a hospital.

claims.claim: Unofficial results gave Mike Hurley 28,946 votes, 58.43 percent of 50,326 ballots, to Heymann Yip's 9,250 votes, 18.67 percent.
claims.episode_span: Hurley won a six-way mayoral race with 28,946 votes, 58.43 percent of 50,326 ballots cast.
claims.source_title: Mike Hurley wins third term as Burnaby mayor
claims.supporting_quote: Unofficial results show Hurley winning the six-way mayoral race handily with 28,946 votes (58.43 per cent of the 50,326 ballots cast) compared to Burnaby First mayoral candidate Heymann Yip who got the second-most votes with 9,250 (18.67 per cent).

claims.claim: Burnaby voter turnout was 29.23 percent, compared with 19.7 percent in 2022.
claims.episode_span: Voter turnout in Burnaby rose to 29.23 percent of eligible voters, from 19.7 percent in 2022.
claims.source_title: Mike Hurley wins third term as Burnaby mayor
claims.supporting_quote: Voter turnout in Burnaby was up this election, with 29.23 per cent of eligible voters casting a ballot compared to just 19.7 per cent in 2022.
